arStrings.szText: {c_important}Skeleton Mage's{/c} maximum number of mages is increased by {c_number}{SF_36}{/c}.

{c_important}Skeleton Mage{/c} is also a {c_important}Corpse{/c} Skill and requires a Corpse to be raised.

Each active skeletal mage increases your Essence Regeneration by {c_number}[{SF_49} * 100}|%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Skeleton Mage{/c} will consume all of your remaining Essence on cast to raise a more powerful but temporary mage.

The skeletal mage deals {c_number}[{SF_51} * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage and lasts for {c_number}[{SF_52}|1|]{/c} seconds for each point of Essence consumed.

{c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} deal {c_number}[SF_16*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage. This bonus increases by {c_number}[SF_5*100|%|]{/c} every second that the skeletal mage is alive, up to {c_number}[SF_16*100+(SF_5*SF_7*100)|x%|]{/c}.
You gain an additional {c_number}[{SF_42}*100|%+|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance against enemies damaged by {c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c}.
{c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} deal {c_number}[SF_43*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.

{c_important}Skeleton Mages{/c} have a {c_number}[SF_45*100|%|]{/c} chance to grant {c_number}1{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/c}{/u}, {c_important}{u}Resolve{/c}{/u}, or {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u} whenever they attack based on whether your {c_important}Skeleton Mage{/c} type is Shadow, Cold, or Bone respectively.
